findings.finding: The execution-profile stance/evidence substitutes a general anti-class-war proposition for the source's specific, qualified inference that the June–July phase moved closer to social discrimination. The evidence summary also introduces discrimination against lower classes as a target account absent from this passage.
findings.recommended_action: Rewrite the stance and synthesis evidence around the changed phase, preserving that many victims may also have engaged in subversive activity. Use legacy SUBJ-04661509BFF9/UNC-0790C024035C as a source-checked formulation, then independently reverify.

findings.finding: The discovery relationship says the Great Terror is enabled_by the Prairial law. The final relationship retains Great Terror as source and the law as target but normalizes type to enables, reversing the causal direction. A second final edge REL-E772A101C09E correctly has the law cause the Great Terror, making the inconsistency concrete.
findings.recommended_action: Keep the endpoint order and type enabled_by, or reverse endpoints for enables. Audit inverse-relation normalization separately without treating the entire graph as invalid.

findings.finding: The western-pacification task acquires section-suppression, Dantonist-purge and centralization subjects, which do not answer the task on the inspected pages. It omits the directly relevant final treaty record SUBJ-904B87A15C7D and British-plan record SUBJ-9B94BFBE1018. Discovery task routes correctly named western insurgency, Hoche, agreements and British plans.
findings.recommended_action: Resolve from the original route meanings to treaty, western-insurgency, conciliation and British-plan subjects; remove unrelated targets. Recheck any automated local-to-final mapping used for other tasks.

findings.finding: Food/price-action discovery becomes part of an Assignats lifecycle subject. Text and evidence remain, including sugar/grain access, but the specific female popular-price-fixing reader route is absent and the source's explicit colonial-scarcity-to-price-action connection has no incident final relationship to SUBJ-0188 except a different financial-basis link.
findings.recommended_action: Retain a food/price-action component and a women/price-fixing task or route; add the source-grounded colonial-crisis relationship. Splitting is one option, not mandatory.

findings.finding: The legacy meaning presents peasant defensive motivation more categorically than the author's explicitly tentative inference. Native SUBJ-0273 preserves that uncertainty in both stance and synthesis evidence.
findings.recommended_action: Qualify the legacy interpretation as the source's suggested explanation and preserve competing uncertainty rather than stating motives as settled.

word_count_provenance.reproducibility_judgment: Historical totals are not independently reproduced. The supplied metadata does not fully specify deterministic tokenization, normalization, region selection and repair/transcription ledgers. Legacy CHUNK-009/010 supplies page accounting, improving internal auditability but not proving extraction reproducibility. Native methods are sparse or absent for CHUNK-007/008/012. Neither has a demonstrated common denominator across this assignment.
verified_specific_differences: CHUNK-010 legacy includes map caption and labels; native explicitly excludes internals and retains caption. Visual page225 confirms substantive labels/legend are present but Poppler extraction returned only caption.
CHUNK-011 legacy excludes chapter title; native explicitly retains it.
CHUNK-009 legacy mentions navigation-only cross-reference exclusions and substantive note retention; native declares a simpler header/folio filter.
CHUNK-012 legacy declares lexical tokens, hyphen repairs and isolated-marker exclusions; native provides no equivalent deterministic token specification in inspected provenance.
recommended_protocol: Freeze one shared region manifest for the exact source SHA-256 and page map. Count each owned document page once; exclude duplicated context pages. Do not import any benchmark subject count into this denominator.

Pin extraction program and version, command line, Unicode normalization (NFKC), and source/chunk/sidecar hashes. Store raw page text privately; record page-level hashes without publishing source prose.

Record page regions by role and coordinates. Include substantive body text, block quotations, substantive inspectable footnotes and captions. Exclude folios, repeating heads, isolated note callouts with absent notes, scale numerals, and purely navigational cross-references. Retain chapter title words as chapter text consistently, excluding the bare chapter number. If the adopted policy instead excludes title display, compute that declared variant for every unit rather than mixing conventions.

Map225 needs a policy decision before a single comparable denominator: primary caption-only variant excludes internal map labels/legend as graph internals; a separately declared substantive-map-text variant includes human-transcribed labels and legend and excludes scale numerals. Hash the transcription and have it visually checked. Never claim either historical total proves that choice.

Use one exact token rule: after approved line-wrap repairs and whitespace collapse, a word is a maximal whitespace-delimited token containing at least one Unicode letter or decimal digit; count standalone punctuation as zero. Keep internal apostrophes and genuine hyphens as one token, numeric values as one. Maintain an explicit page/line repair ledger for joined soft or line-end hyphenation; preserve genuine lexical hyphens. Do not silently infer all end-line hyphens are soft.

Write per-page included/excluded counts, normalized-text hashes, repair/transcription manifest hashes and chapter totals; independently rerun to the same counts. Verify sums and ownership. Publish only totals and method metadata; retain extracted source and ledgers privately.

For later density measurement, use this single W_c for both lineages/comparands: heading-path rate=1000*H_c/W_c; locator-occurrence rate=1000*L_c/W_c. Apply the declared policy scoring and word-weighted aggregation at chapter level, rounding only after aggregation. No numerators were inspected or computed here; density must never be a discovery quota or benchmark-selection criterion.

recommendation.rationale: Verified defects occur in both lineages. Native consolidations often preserve the full causal interpretation and avoid multiplying requirements for one connected passage. Legacy often preserves valuable named access routes, specific reader questions and the Great Terror qualification. Correct the demonstrated defects and retain defensible routes without copying counts or every local split.
